title: Austin Growth: Highland Hills Annexation Begins
summary:
*   A special meeting was held solely to address the expansion of Austin's city limits.
*   Officials initiated the annexation of a 6.11-acre tract of land, known as Highland Hills, Section 5, Phase 4.
*   An ordinance outlining the new boundary limits was introduced, given its first reading, and ordered to be published for public notice.
